description:
BETA — Kampagnen des OpenAI-Ads-Kontos, neueste zuerst. Je Kampagne id, name,
status (active/paused/archived), objective, bidding_type (clicks, impressions
oder conversions), budget {daily, lifetime} in Kontowährung, start_time/end_time
(UTC), conversion_event_setting_ids (verknüpfte Conversion-Ereignisse) und
targeting. status: optional nur active, paused oder archived.
Kennzahlen: openai_ads_insights. Anzeigengruppen: openai_ads_list_ad_groups.
workspace: Slug des Kunden-Workspace (optional bei nur einem Workspace).
name: openai_ads_list_campaigns
title: OpenAI Ads (Beta): List campaigns
